class.name: GodotPhysXBlastProbe
class.brief_description: Internal test bridge for NVIDIA Blast runtime fracture.
class.description: Drives the Blast damage, fracture, split and rigid body spawn path directly from a script, without a scene node. It loads a raw [code]NvBlastAsset[/code] dump and a per-chunk mesh dump, applies radial damage and spawns a physics body for every chunk that breaks off. Used by the module's headless tests; for games use [PhysXDestructible3D]. [b]Note:[/b] This is an internal test class of the PhysX module, not a stable API: it may change or be removed without notice.

method.name: apply_radial_damage
method.description: Applies radial damage at [param position] to every live actor: full [param damage] within [param min_radius], falling off to zero at [param max_radius]. Actors that fracture are split, and a rigid body is spawned for each newly separated chunk. Returns the number of bodies spawned by this call.

method.name: get_body
method.description: Returns the physics body [RID] of the spawned chunk at [param index] (0 to [method get_body_count] - 1).

method.name: get_body_count
method.description: Returns the number of chunk bodies spawned so far.

method.name: get_live_actor_count
method.description: Returns the number of Blast actors (connected groups of chunks) currently alive.

method.name: load
method.description: Loads a raw [code]NvBlastAsset[/code] file ([param asset_path]) and the matching plain text per-chunk triangle dump ([param chunks_path]). Any path [FileAccess] can open works. Returns [code]true[/code] on success.

method.name: set_base_transform
method.description: Sets the world transform of the unbroken object; spawned chunk bodies are placed relative to it.

method.name: set_base_velocity
method.description: Sets the linear velocity given to newly spawned chunk bodies.

method.name: set_space
method.description: Sets the physics space (for example [code]get_world_3d().space[/code]) that spawned chunk bodies are added to. The space must use the PhysX backend.
